Konke okusemaZulwini naseMhlabeni kudumisa u Allah, onguMbusi, oNgcwele, onguSomandla oKhaliphile.
Nguyena owaqoka kwabangafundile iSithunywa kubo esibafundela imibiko Yakhe, sibahlanze futhi sibafundisa iNcwadi kanye neHikima; nakuba endulo babesekudukeni imbala.
Kanti abanye babo baseza emuvakwabo, futhi nguYena onguSomandla oKhaliphile.
Lokho kuwumusa ka Allah awupha amthandayo, bheka ngoba u Allah unomusa omkhulu.

Labo abathwesa ukulandela iTora kepha bangayilandela, bafaniswa nembongolo ethwele imiqulu yezincwadi; saze sasibi isifaniso salabo abaphika imibiko yaka Allah; kanti futhi u Allah akabaholi labo abaphambukile.
Yithi: “Nina eningamaJuda uma niqakambisa ukuthi ningabangani baka Allah ngale kwabanye abantu, langazelelani- ke ukufa uma ngempela niqinisile”.
Kepha abasoze bakulangezelela ngenxa yezenzo zabo; kantike u Allah ubazi kahle abaphambukile.
Yithi: “Ukufa lokhu enikubalekelayo, empeleni kuyanifica, bese nibuyiselwa kuMazi wokungabonwa nokubonwayo, abe esenazisa ngebenikwenza.
Nina enikholwayo! Uma sekumenyezelwa iSwala ngosuku lweJuma, phuthumelani enkumbuzweni ka Allah nishiye ukuhweba. Yikona lokho okuhle kini uma nje benazi.
Uma isiphothuliwe iSwala, chithekani emhlabeni nizithungathele emseni ka Allah, nikhumbule u Allah kakhulu ukuze niphumelele.
Uma sebebona uhwebo noma umcimbi baphuma kuwo bakushiye wena umile. Yithi: “Okuku Allah kungcono kunomcimbi nohwebo, futhi u Allah nguyena uMondli ongcono.
